base_plate.description: Mounting plate with central bore and bolt holes

housing.description: Main housing block with vertical through-bore for shaft passage

shaft.description: Stepped cylindrical shaft with two diameter sections

flange.description: Mounting flange with central bore and bolt holes for coaxial alignment

bushing.description: Cylindrical bushing sleeve for shaft step 1

shaft_step1_in_bushing.description: Shaft step 1 (diam 38) inserts into bushing bore (spec diam 40) with clearance fit

shaft_step2_in_housing.description: Shaft step 2 (diam 24) inserts into housing bore (spec diam 40)

flange_base_bore_match.description: Flange and base_plate central bores must both be diam 40 for coaxial alignment

housing_bore_axis.description: Housing bore axis must be vertical (Z-direction) for top-down shaft insertion
